study: Uniform Before pipeline and undersampling pipeline. (1) Uniform: every model handles class imbalance the same way: the U-Net's capped inverse-frequency class weights, all training data, no resampling (the RF is retrained with those weights and without its region cap; the U-Net and U-Net + CRF already match and are reused). (2) Undersampling: every model keeps all target pixels/regions and a fixed ratio r:1 of 'Other' to targets, without class weights; r is chosen on validation. (3) Blackening test: as (2) but the 'Other' pixels of the training photos are painted black; validated and tested on real photos. Added after all earlier test results were seen; validation-only choices; own freeze; test scored once.

undersample.rule: Keep every flooded-building and flooded-road pixel (U-Net) or region (RF). Keep 'Other' at r times the number of target pixels/regions of the budget's training set: the U-Net keeps each 'Other' pixel with probability min(1, r * target_pixels / other_pixels) from a fixed, seeded draw per image (the same subset every epoch; dropped pixels are ignored by the loss, the photo is unchanged); the RF keeps a seeded random sample of min(#other, round(r * #target)) 'Other' regions. No class weights. The U-Net + CRF applies the frozen CRF setting to each undersampled U-Net.

blacken.rule: Training photos only: every pixel whose 3-class label is 'Other' is set to black (0, 0, 0); padding and target pixels are unchanged. Undersampling as in the undersampling pipeline with the ratio chosen there (per budget and model family). Validation and test photos are real and unmodified.
blacken.reason: Requested test of blackening the unneeded classes. The masks used to blacken do not exist for new photos, so the model can only be scored on real photos.

ratio_rule: For each budget and model family (U-Net decides for the U-Net + CRF; the RF decides for itself): the ratio with the highest mean validation flooded mIoU over the 3 seeds; ties go to the smaller ratio. Only the chosen ratio's runs are scored on the test split.
comparisons: Undersampling (chosen r) and blackening against the uniform Before of the same budget and seed (U-Net and U-Net + CRF: the frozen originals; RF: the uniform RF). The uniform RF against the first-version RF.
hybrid: The frozen DenseCRF setting from runs/hybrid_selection.json, unchanged.
scoring: Every prediction is scored on the frozen 256-px test grid against the same 3-class masks as all earlier runs.
metrics: Primary: minority IoU (flooded mIoU, mean IoU of flooded building and flooded road). Also reported: majority IoU (Other), weighted mIoU (class IoU weighted by true-pixel share), 3-class mIoU, pixel accuracy, per-class IoU / precision / recall / Dice.
unchanged: U-Net architecture, optimiser, batch size, augmentation, 30 epochs with patience 6
test split scored once after the freeze
decision_rule: helps: 95% CI of the seed-mean pooled flooded-mIoU difference vs baseline excludes 0 above, and all 3 seed-matched differences are positive; hurts: CI excludes 0 below and all 3 negative; otherwise no clear effect
